title: Delete or wire up the unused ChazaraStatus/MomentumStatus domain models and their barrel
why: Repo-wide grep for ChazaraStatus, MomentumStatus, and this models.dart barrel path finds no reference anywhere outside their own declaration and generated .freezed.dart files — no provider constructs them, no widget renders them. They are fully-specified, richly-documented (momentum thresholds, chazara due/overdue semantics) value classes for a feature that was designed but never wired up, and the models.dart barrel that exists to re-export them is itself imported by nothing. Each carries a generated .freezed.dart companion that build_runner keeps regenerating for code nothing calls.
recommendation: Delete chazara_status.dart, momentum_status.dart, their .freezed.dart companions, and models.dart, or land the provider/widget that was supposed to consume them.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rln 'ChazaraStatus\|MomentumStatus' lib/ returns zero results outside the deleted files, or shows a real consumer.
dart run build_runner build after deletion produces no orphaned .freezed.dart output for these files.
